text: ♫ (Instrumental Intro) ♫
[Verse 1]
Saiyaara, saiyaara, mere dil ka nazaara
Tu hi toh hai, meri rooh ka kinaara
Andheri raaton mein, roshni tu laaye
Har mod pe meri, himmat badhaaye
Palkon pe tera naam, dil mein hai basaa
Tujh bin har safar, lagta hai adhoora
[Chorus]
Saiyaara, saiyaara, tu meri kahaani
Saiyaara, saiyaara, meri rooh ki nishaani
Jab tak saansein chalein, tu hi mera pyaar
Tera saath ho toh, jeetun har haar
♫ (Instrumental Break) ♫
[Verse 2]
Dooriyon mein bhi, nazdeekiyaan hain
Teri yaadon mein bhi, gehraaiyaan hain
Koi bandhan nahi, koi deewar nahi
Bas tu hi tu hai, aur koi nahi
[Chorus]
Saiyaara, saiyaara, tu meri kahaani
Saiyaara, saiyaara, meri rooh ki nishaani
Jab tak saansein chalein, tu hi mera pyaar
Tera saath ho toh, jeetun har haar
♫ (Instrumental Break) ♫
[Bridge]
Aasmaan ki hadd tak, chalo hum ud jaayen
Ek dooje mein kahin, aaj kho jaayen
Yeh ishq hai ya junoon, kya naam doon
Bas tere saath hi, har pal jiyoon
Meri har dua mein, tu hi tu hai shamil
Tu na ho toh lage, jaise sab hai mushkil
[Chorus]
Saiyaara, saiyaara, tu meri kahaani
Saiyaara, saiyaara, meri rooh ki nishaani
Jab tak saansein chalein, tu hi mera pyaar
Tera saath ho toh, jeetun har haar
♫ (Instrumental Break - Extended) ♫
[Verse 3]
Har ek sitaara, teri hi baat kare
Chand bhi teri roop ki fariyaad kare
Tere ishq mein hum, aise hain kho gaye
Khud ko bhulakar, bas tere ho gaye
[Chorus]
Saiyaara, saiyaara, tu meri kahaani
Saiyaara, saiyaara, meri rooh ki nishaani
Jab tak saansein chalein, tu hi mera pyaar
Tera saath ho toh, jeetun har haar
♫ (Instrumental Build-up) ♫
Saiyaara... oh Saiyaara...
Meri zindagi ki, tu hi hai roshni
Har khwahish, har pal, tu hi ban gayi
[Outro]
Saiyaara, saiyaara...
Zindagi ka har raasta...
Bas tujh tak jaayega...
Saiyaara... Saiyaara...
Tu hi toh hai... mera pyaar...
♫ (Music fades out slowly) ♫
Saiyaara...
End
